bloom.name: Mother Bloom
bloom.blurb: A rooted flower that floods the room with spores and spawns slimes.
bloom.lore: Before she rooted, she was Ilsa’s first companion: a Puffcap named Biscuit. The Bloom keeps what it takes and grows it into something it can use. Some part of her still turns toward the hideout’s light.

wyrm.name: Cinder Wyrm
wyrm.blurb: A burning serpent that circles you, breathes fire and dashes trailing embers.
wyrm.lore: The Wyrm was a Mycelisk that swallowed a forge coal from the old Keepers’ camp. It never stopped burning. The scorch marks on Floor 3 are a hundred years old.

king.name: The Hollow King
king.blurb: A crowned knight that blinks around the room, cutting lines of blades and calling his guard.
king.lore: The first Keeper. He tried to rule the Bloom instead of leaving it. It let him, and hollowed him out from the inside. The knights that follow him are his old crew.

roc.name: Storm Roc
roc.blurb: A thunderbird that dives across the room and scatters feather volleys.
roc.lore: The Roc was born in the Bloom and never cut free. It has flown the same three floors its whole life, looking for a sky. Its feathers still smell like rain.

leviathan.name: Abyssal Leviathan
leviathan.blurb: A sea serpent that surrounds you in tidal rings with one way out.
leviathan.lore: There is an underground sea below the Abyss, and the Leviathan is how the Bloom drinks it. Ilsa’s Tidewyrm, Marrowtail, went into the water after her and came back as this.

matriarch.name: Crystal Matriarch
matriarch.blurb: A living geode that splits light into crossing beams and shard storms.
matriarch.lore: Every crystal creature on the upper floors is a chip off her. She sheds them so they can wander up toward the light, because she cannot.

choir.name: Void Choir
choir.blurb: Three watching eyes that sing spirals in harmony and call shades.
choir.lore: Three Echo creatures that tried to call for help from the deep and were heard by the wrong thing. They still sing. Ilsa wrote down the melody. It is the song the hideout music box plays.

prime.name: Iron Colossus Prime
prime.blurb: A walking siege engine. Slams send shockwaves; launchers fire seeking shells.
prime.lore: The old Keepers built it to dig straight down to the heart. It reached the sixth floor before the roots got into its gears. It still digs in its sleep.
